title: Pure Infernal Flame
summary: The Infernal Flame Pyro strategy built around Infernal Flame Emperor, Infernal Flame Banshee, and Infernal Flame Vixen, supported by Bonfire, Rekindling, Blaster, Dragon Ruler of Infernos, and 200 DEF Flamvell extenders.

summary.title: Starters
points: Bonfire searches any Level 4 or lower Pyro monster (Spirit of Flames, Solar Flare Dragon, or Neo Flamvell Lady).
Flamvell Firedog Special Summons Neo Flamvell Lady (200 DEF Pyro) from the Deck on battle destruction for an immediate Rank 4 Xyz Summon.
Infernal Flame Banshee detaches 1 material to add any Pyro monster (such as Infernal Flame Emperor or Spirit of Flames) from your Deck to your hand or send it to the GY.

summary.title: Opening: Level 4 Pyro + Spirit of Flames (or Rekindling)
steps: Normal Summon a Level 4 Pyro (or summon two 200 DEF FIRE monsters with Rekindling) and Special Summon Spirit of Flames by banishing a FIRE monster from your GY.
Overlay two Level 4 monsters into Infernal Flame Banshee, then detach 1 material to search Infernal Flame Emperor or dump a Pyro to the GY.

When Banshee is in the GY while you control a Pyro, banish her via Spirit of Flames, Blaster, Dragon Ruler of Infernos, or Infernal Flame Emperor's Tribute Summon to Special Summon Banshee back to the field with +100 ATK per banished monster.

summary.title: Bosses & Payoff
points: Infernal Flame Emperor (Level 9, 2700 ATK) can be Tribute Summoned for 1 Tribute by Tributing a Pyro; on Tribute Summon, it banishes up to 5 FIRE monsters from your GY (triggering Infernal Flame Banshee) to destroy that many Spell/Trap Cards on the field.

Infernal Flame Vixen detaches 1 material to boost its ATK to 2700 until the end of the opponent's turn, and banishes up to 3 monsters from either GY when destroyed on the field (also triggering Banshee if she is among them).
Two Solar Flare Dragons on the field lock the opponent out of declaring attacks while burning for 500 damage each during every End Phase.
Blaster, Dragon Ruler of Infernos banishes 2 FIRE monsters from hand or GY to Special Summon itself, or discards itself with a FIRE monster to destroy 1 card on the field.

summary.title: Spells
points: Rekindling revives all copies of Neo Flamvell Lady and Flamvell Firedog (both 200 DEF FIRE) from your GY to assemble both Infernal Flame Banshee and Infernal Flame Vixen.
Circle of the Fire Kings destroys a FIRE monster you control (such as Infernal Flame Vixen to trigger its triple GY banish) to Special Summon Infernal Flame Emperor or Banshee from your GY.
Royal Firestorm Guards shuffles 4 Pyro monsters from your GY into the Deck to draw 2 cards.

main: Infernal Flame Emperor

Signature Level 9 FIRE Pyro boss (2700 ATK / 1600 DEF; directly searchable by Infernal Flame Banshee!): when Tribute Summoned, banishes up to 5 FIRE monsters from your GY (triggering Infernal Flame Banshee!) to destroy an equal number of Spell/Trap Cards on the field.
Spirit of Flames

Level 4 FIRE Pyro (1700 ATK): banishes 1 FIRE monster from your GY (including Infernal Flame Banshee, immediately reviving Banshee!) to Special Summon itself from your hand and gains 300 ATK during your Battle Phase.
Solar Flare Dragon
Level 4 FIRE Pyro (1500 ATK): cannot be attacked while you control another Pyro monster, burns for 500 every End Phase, and overlays into Infernal Flame Vixen.
Neo Flamvell Lady
Level 4 FIRE Pyro (200 DEF): sends a FIRE monster from hand to GY as a Quick Effect to banish a card from the opponent's GY, and dumps a 200 DEF FIRE monster from Deck to GY.
Royal Firestorm Guards
Level 4 FIRE Pyro (1700 ATK) that recycles 4 Pyro monsters from your GY into the Deck to draw 2 cards.
Flamvell Firedog
Level 4 FIRE monster (1900 ATK / 200 DEF) that summons Neo Flamvell Lady from the Deck to immediately overlay into Infernal Flame Banshee or Infernal Flame Vixen.
Blaster, Dragon Ruler of Infernos
Banishes 2 FIRE monsters from your hand/GY to Special Summon itself from hand or GY.
Bonfire
Limited to 1 in TCG: adds any Level 4 or lower Pyro monster (Spirit of Flames, Solar Flare Dragon, or Neo Flamvell Lady) from your Deck to your hand.
Rekindling
Special Summons Neo Flamvell Lady and Flamvell Firedog from your GY to assemble both Infernal Flame Banshee and Infernal Flame Vixen in a single turn.
Circle of the Fire Kings
Destroys Infernal Flame Vixen on the field to revive Infernal Flame Emperor or Infernal Flame Banshee from your GY.
extra: Signature Rank 4 FIRE Pyro Xyz (2 Level 4 monsters): detaches 1 material to add ANY Pyro monster from your Deck to your hand or send it to the GY; if banished while you control a Pyro monster, Special Summons itself and gains +100 ATK per banished monster!

Signature Rank 4 FIRE Pyro Xyz (2 FIRE Pyro-Type monsters; 2200 ATK): detaches 1 material to gain 500 ATK until the end of your opponent's turn; when destroyed on the field, banishes up to 3 monsters from either GY!
Link-2: Quick Effect Link Summons during opponent's Main Phase and gives the summoned monster effect-destruction immunity.
